prompt.generated_prompt_string: A late-1990s or Y2K-inspired dreamy grainy flash photograph of a clearly adult woman in a high-rise apartment at night. She has very long medium-brown hair pulled into a loose bun with a few strands framing her face, full brows, winged eyeliner, light pink lipstick, fair natural complexion, and a serious direct gaze. She wears a short opaque burgundy strapless dress with a corset-inspired textured-lace bodice and textured-lace skirt, plus small silver dangling earrings. Frame her in a 3:4 close-up at eye level while seated on a light-gray sofa, with her right hand resting naturally on the midsection and left arm along the sofa back. Show large windows with numerous city lights at night and a white pillow. Use direct on-camera flash with city ambient fill, crisp highlights on skin, opaque dress texture, jewelry, and hair, visible film grain, soft yet high contrast, muted highlights, natural skin texture, and subtle lens bloom. Use an approved generic adult model rather than a public-figure likeness.
